why: The item lists two definitions and one witness theorem. A is the type of the witness, isManifoldType_indicator: the indicator of a point of ℝⁿ is of manifold type in the trivial ep-groupoid; it has no universe parameters. B says the project's IsManifoldType and IsOrbifoldType are the text's notions for every ep-groupoid in Type and every Θ : Obj → ℚ. B is proved outright (B_holds). IsOrbifoldType is literally B's IsZeroOneB. The project's 'two morphisms with the same source and target in supp Θ are equal' is B's 'at most one morphism between x, y ∈ supp Θ' with the quantifiers rearranged (x = y is allowed on both sides). So the definitions agree. A_to_B is B_holds and does not use A. B_to_A rewrites IsManifoldType with B and checks the indicator directly.
overlap: B_to_A: 380 shared project theorems. All come from the construction of trivial (rnPolyfold n) in A's statement (rnChart, sub-M-polyfold, sc-retraction and product glue, paracompactness), which isManifoldType_indicator's statement also reaches. None is a Chapter 9 lemma.
